text:
Hi Sarah,

I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting and I'd like to get it on the calendar with you before the rest of the week fills up.

Looking at my schedule for the week of Nov 23, the genuinely free windows are short:

- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
- Mon 10:00-10:30

Which of those works for you? If a 30-minute slot is too tight for what you want to cover, tell me and I'll see what I can move — but I'd rather not touch lectures, office hours or the department's fixed items.

Once you pick one, I'll book it and log it. Anything you want on the agenda, send it along and I'll have it in front of us.

— Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez,

Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me — I've put it on my calendar.

Agenda:
1. Last quiz section (Tue 16:20) — I'd like to change one exercise and confirm the grading key we hand the graders.
2. Grade turnaround: HW4 grades out before the Thanksgiving break?
3. Brief check on TA hours for the last two weeks of term.

If you'd rather drop any of those for the half hour, say so and I'll come with a shorter list.

— Sarah

Sarah,

Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is — booked on my side and logged. It sits right after my grant-writing block and clears before the research meeting at 15:30, so you won't be rushed out.

All three agenda items fit the half hour; don't shorten your list. What I'd like from you beforehand:

1. **Quiz section (Tue 16:20)** — send me the exercise you want changed and the current grading key by Monday evening, so I can read them rather than skim them in the room.
2. **HW4 grades** — let's settle the turnaround decision on Tuesday, but bring your realistic estimate of grading hours left; if we have to move the deadline, I'd rather make that call Tuesday and tell the graders the same day than discover it the Friday before break.
3. **TA hours** — bring the last two weeks' coverage at a glance, and flag any section that's thin.

See you Tuesday.

— Professor Alvarez

Understood — all three stay on the list.

I've blocked Monday 12:20-13:10 for the prep and set a reminder for Monday 12:20 to send you the quiz exercise and the current grading key, so they're in your inbox well before Monday evening. For Tuesday I'll bring:

1. revised exercise + current key (already sent Monday)
2. realistic grading hours left for HW4 and a go/no-go on moving the deadline
3. last two weeks' TA coverage at a glance, with the thin sections flagged

See you Tuesday 15:00.

— Sarah

Perfect — that's exactly what I wanted. Monday 12:20 it is on your side; if the exercise needs my read before Tuesday, say so and I'll make time Monday afternoon.

See you Tuesday 15:00.

— Professor Alvarez
Noted — I'll flag it Monday if I think it needs your read before Tuesday. See you then.
